description: Replay governance for the DB harness (Phase 2 spec §D.4, proposed D-131). Every legacy migration (version < 20261123000000) replays in version order, each in its own transaction; files not listed here are 'apply'. 'driftBefore' runs drift patches (supabase/tests/harness/drift/, live schema state only) before the file. 'expect_failure' needs reason, evidence and errorMatch, and fails the run if the file applies. 'skip' needs supersededBy or a reason. 'fidelityExceptions' explains types.ts objects the replay cannot reproduce. Legacy files are never edited.

20260228120000_create_feedback_submissio.reason: Not applied live: MIGRATIONS-LEDGER.md row 1 is 'written, not applied' (feedback_submissions is absent from types.ts) and the Apply queue holds it until X6 decides (R3). The replay reproduces live after the Apply queue, so the held file is left out.

20260428170829_00553f3f-cc1f-4c05-8442-a.reason: Its vessels seed needs company 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111, which existed live (Lovable ran this file) but no migration creates.

20260917113000_hris_phase1_followups.sql.reason: Hand-written HRIS phase 1 follow-ups; it never ran live as written. Lovable applied a corrected copy, 20260917175431_780bf2a9-cf3e-40be-a9b2-f37c8fff5950.sql (ledger row 7: 95 %, 30 of its 33 new statements), which replays here and carries the rest.
20260917113000_hris_phase1_followups.sql.evidence: Its audit_logs SELECT policy compares 'ca.id::text = audit_logs.entity_id' with audit_logs.entity_id uuid (20260127120753_96ffc917-b51e-4b1a-8dd1-263dc4c70d3e.sql creates it as 'entity_id UUID NOT NULL'; no migration changes its type). The Lovable copy writes the same policy as 'audit_logs.entity_id::text' (lines 46, 54, 62): the statement as written failed live with this error. types.ts cannot tell (entity_id: string for uuid and text alike), and the Lovable copies of rows 7 and 11 insert uuid values (20260917181151 line 69 'p_profile_id' where the hand-written row 11 had 'p_profile_id::text'), so the live column is uuid and a type drift patch would make the replay differ from live. docs/HEALTH.md (line 129) records the same: both files fail to replay on this policy, 'where both columns are uuid', and the live project is unaffected because the Lovable copies create a working version.
20260917113000_hris_phase1_followups.sql.errorMatch: operator does not exist: text = uuid

20260917140000_hris_phase4_recruitment_o.reason: Its hr_expiry_items view reads profiles.visa_expiry, which the failed hand-written row 7 adds; live, the phase 4 copy ran after the row 7 copy had added the column.

20260917150000_hris_phase5_retention.sql.reason: Hand-written HRIS phase 5 retention; it never ran live as written. Lovable applied a corrected copy, 20260917181151_83a5b472-ef4b-4d26-9f66-4412934a9d32.sql (ledger row 11: 97 %, 101 of its 105 new statements), which replays here and carries the rest.
20260917150000_hris_phase5_retention.sql.evidence: Line 238 is the audit_logs SELECT policy with 'ca.id::text = audit_logs.entity_id' against the uuid column (see the row 7 entry). The Lovable copy writes it as 'audit_logs.entity_id::text' (lines 191, 197, 201) and inserts 'p_profile_id' (uuid) where this file has 'p_profile_id::text' (copy lines 68-69 vs line 84): the copy is the corrected text that ran live. docs/HEALTH.md (line 129) records the same failure and that live runs the Lovable copy.
20260917150000_hris_phase5_retention.sql.errorMatch: operator does not exist: text = uuid

tables.dev_todos: Exists live (types.ts) but no migration in the repo creates it and nothing reads it (only types.ts names it under src/). Only its column names and TS types are known; its SQL types, defaults, RLS and policies are recorded nowhere in the repo, so a drift patch would be a guess. No migration, policy, function or app path depends on it.
